verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party Consent Management feature to capture consent, and its compliance toolkit claims to continuously sync consent preferences downstream to every tool. The evidence consists of high-level marketing and docs-index statements, so automatic enforcement of consent categories is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that events are blocked or filtered per destination by consent category, detail on how opt-outs are enforced automatically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically

citations.quote: Consent Management Capture consent and stay compliant with GDPR and CCPA
Set up seamless flows to continuously capture and sync consent preferences downstream to every tool in your stack.
When users update preferences or request to be deleted, push the change to your entire stack from one centralized platform.
